name: Apertus-v1.5-70B-base
params.note: 70B is a size designation; the checkpoint's 71,942,010,689 parameters include the image and audio tokenizers and the 266,752-row input embedding.
shape.tokenizer: byte-level BPE (Mistral-Nemo tekken, 131,072) extended with 200 reserved slots, 131,072 image codes (Emu3.5 vision tokenizer, one per 16×16 patch) and 4,096 audio codes (WavTokenizer)
ffn.activation: xIELU (non-gated; trainable α_p, α_n per layer)
ctx.extension: 8K → 32K → 65K → 131K → 262K after the stage-3 cooldown, 58.7B, 58.7B, 50.3B, 50.3B tokens; constant LR 2e-6, fresh optimizer per step; RoPE base 2M then 4M, Llama-3 scaling factor 8, 8, 16, 32; context parallelism 4, 8, 16, 32
train.optimizer: AdEMAMix (α 8, β3 0.9999, α and β3 warmup over 100,000 iterations)
train.schedule: Apertus 1.0: WSD, warmup from 0.1× peak, constant 1e-5, 1-sqrt cooldown to 1e-6 over 13.5T–15T; Apertus 1.5: re-warm 0 → 2e-5, constant through stages 1–2, 1-sqrt decay to 2e-6 over stage 3, constant 2e-6 in context extension
train.warmup: 16.78B tokens from 0.1× peak (Apertus 1.0); 250 iterations, 4.2B tokens, from 0 (Apertus 1.5)
train.batch: Apertus 1.0: 2,048 × 4,096 (8.4M tokens), doubled to 16.8M tokens at 4.4T; Apertus 1.5: 2,048 × 8,192 (16.8M tokens), held constant through context extension
train.precision: BF16 (Apertus 1.0 pretraining; an FP8 trial on the 8B was rolled back)
train.init: Apertus 1.0: std 0.008944; Apertus 1.5: new image/audio embedding and output rows random at ~1/10 the norm of trained text rows
train.stability: QK-norm; grad clip 0.1; weight decay on norm gains and xIELU parameters
train.masking: cross-document attention masking; position ids reset at document boundaries
train.objective: Goldfish loss (k = 50, h = 50: ~2% of targets dropped by hashed 50-token context); image and audio tokens are targets only in Apertus 1.5 stage 1
train.data: Apertus 1.0: 15T text in 1811 languages, robots.txt opt-outs applied retroactively, five data phases with rising math/code share (DCLM-Edu and FineWeb-2-HQ top 10% from 12T); Apertus 1.5 stages 1–3: 668B vision, 234B audio (both incl. paired text), 1,111B text-only tokens
train.hardware: NVIDIA GH200 on Alps (CSCS); Apertus 1.0 70B on 2048–4096 GPUs over several months; Apertus 1.5 on 512 nodes (2048 GPUs)
train.compute: 6.74e24 FLOPs and ~6M GPU-hours for the 15T Apertus 1.0 run; ~1.50M GPU-hours (logged segments) for Apertus 1.5 stages 1–3
scaling.hp_rule: peak LR 2e-5 = 2× Apertus 1.0 70B peak, chosen by ablation
scaling.ladder: 1.5B per-change ablations at 100B tokens, merged into a 3B run at 100B tokens

name: A.X K2

scaling.hp_rule: LR and batch magnitudes from the MoE scaling laws of Tian et al. (2025)

name: Beam-1.0-501B-A23B

name: Step-3.5-Flash-Base
params.note: Backbone only: 198B total / 13B active with the 3 MTP heads; active count excludes embedding and output matrices.
attn.layout: 3 SWA : 1 global (leading global layer + 11 × [3 SWA, 1 global])
attn.position: partial RoPE (global, 64 of 128 dims), RoPE (SWA, all 128 dims)
attn.gate: head-wise scalar sigmoid gate on each head's output, before o_proj; all layers
ffn.clamp: gate capped at 7, up clamped to [−7, 7] in routed experts of layers 43–44; shared expert of layer 44 limit 16
moe.balancing: aux-loss-free bias (update rate 0.001 for the first 14.6T, decayed to 0 during annealing) + EP-group balance loss 0.001
mtp.block: gated SWA attention + dense SwiGLU FFN; H-Norm(hidden) and E-Norm(next-token embedding) concatenated, then linear projection
ctx.extension: last 1T tokens of annealing at 32K; full-attention RoPE θ 10K → 1M, SWA θ stays 10K
train.schedule: 2,000-step linear warmup; cosine 2.5e-4 → 5e-5 over stage 1 (14.6T); cosine 5e-5 → 2e-5 over the 2T 4K anneal; constant 2e-5 for the 1T 32K portion
train.batch: 4,096 → 16,384 × 4,096 (67.1M tokens) over the first 400B tokens, then constant; 2,048 × 32,768 (67.1M tokens) in the 32K anneal
train.precision: mixed precision; Muon Polar Express iteration (state and intermediates) in FP16
train.stability: FP16 Polar Express in Muon; SwiGLU activation clipping in deep MoE layers; zero-centered RMSNorm; QK-norm; head-wise attention gate; per-expert activation/parameter-norm monitoring
train.objective: metadata prefix (content type, language, domain, source) on every sample; its loss masked after ~3.8T tokens; PR-Dialogue template scaffolding masked during annealing
train.data: StepCrawl web and ePub/PDF, code (OpenCoder filters relaxed to ≤6 violations), GitHub PR/issue/commit (incl. 90B PR-Dialogue tokens), math/STEM, synthetic tool-use and reasoning; annealing upweights code, PR/issue/commit and high-quality knowledge
train.hardware: 4,096 NVIDIA H800; 8 GPUs per node, 8×200 Gbps RoCE
scaling.ladder: 30B-A3B (48 layers, d 2048, 1.4T tokens) for attention-layout and data ablations; 100B-A10B (43 layers, d 4096, 250B tokens) for head-wise gate vs sink

name: Trinity-Large-Base
params.note: Card gives ~398B total, report 400B; embedding scope not stated.
shape.tokenizer: byte-level BPE, 200K vocab trained on ~10B tokens; DeepSeek-V3-style pretokenizer with right-aligned 3-digit number chunks and extended script isolation

train.schedule: WSD: 2000-step linear warmup, constant, cosine decay to 1/10 of peak; context extension continues cosine 1/10 → 1/20

train.hardware: 2048 B300; HSDP (FSDP group 128) + EP 8; pretraining 33 days
scaling.parametrization: Muon LR × max(1, √(fan_out/fan_in)) for width transfer; embedding ×√d; init σ = 0.5/√d
